exposure: anterior or posterior trunk of the distal middle cerebral artery occlusion
proximal or distal M1 middle cerebral artery occlusion
cohort: The study included 39 children with perinatal arterial ischemic stroke and 44 children with presumed perinatal venous infarction.
finding: The risk for developing epilepsy after perinatal stroke is highest in children with proximal or distal M1 middle cerebral artery occlusion, and patients with periventricular venous infarction have a more severe course of epilepsy.
